3. GENERATED ALWAYS vs GENERATED BY DEFAULT - you can control behavior.

- SERIAL columns: you can insert explicit values into the serial column, it won't update the sequence.
- GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: if you try to insert an explicit value, it will fail unless you use OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE.

So they are NOT the same mechanism. The answer is 否 (False/No).
